description:
£160 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to present this three-bedroom student property, ideally located in the popular area of Jesmond.

The property offers a spacious open plan living area, creating the perfect space for relaxing and socialising, alongside two bathrooms for added convenience. Situated within walking distance of local amenities, including Tesco, Waitrose and Starbucks, the property is ideally positioned for student living. With excellent public transport links and Newcastle City Centre just a short walk away, this property offers both comfort and convenience in a sought-after location.

To arrange your viewing, contact My Property Box today!
